Name: NPC_THINK_PARAM_ST
Description: Enemy AI settings: senses (sight, hearing, smell), search and forget timers, return-home distances, pathing permissions, team help and the Lua logic and battle goal scripts. NpcParam picks the row; many values are read by the shared AI scripts (aicommon) through GetExcelParam.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds.

Fields.Name: Logic ID
Fields.Description: Lua logic script that runs this AI (its file number, e.g. 10000 → 010000_logic). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Battle Goal ID
Fields.Description: Lua battle goal the logic adds when the NPC fights (its file number, e.g. 431000 → 431000_battle). -1: none. Scripts read it with GetExcelParam(battleGoalID).

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Distance Bonus
Fields.Description: Metres added to Vision - Distance when looking for a character the NPC is already tracking (searching). Not used while Update Battle Vision applies.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Width Angle Bonus
Fields.Description: Degrees added to Vision - Width Angle when looking for a character the NPC is already tracking (searching).

Fields.Name: Don't Avoid Giant Enemy
Fields.Description: When on, pathing ignores the extra cost the navmesh gives to areas meant for huge enemies, so the NPC walks through them instead of detouring.

Fields.Name: Enable Weapon Switch
Fields.Description: When on, the common AI scripts sheathe and draw the weapon by state: out of alert they play Weapon Switch Out - Animation ID while Weapon Switch In - SpEffect ID is on, and when alerted they play Weapon Switch In - Animation ID while Weapon Switch Out - SpEffect ID is on.

Fields.Name: Aim for AI Target Lock Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Read by the AI as a yes/no setting; by its name it makes the AI aim at the target's lock-on dummy poly.

Fields.Name: Ranged Attack - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Used by the failed-path sidestep goal: when both this and Shift Animation ID on Ranged Attack are set and the NPC lacks this SpEffect, it plays the shift animation first. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Search Forget Time - Level 1
Fields.Description: Seconds the NPC keeps a search level 1 target before forgetting it. Goal Action - Target Search Level 1 set to 14 shortens this to 1 second.

Fields.Name: Search Forget Time - Level 2
Fields.Description: Seconds the NPC keeps a search level 2 target before forgetting it. Goal Action - Target Search Level 2 set to 14 shortens this to 1 second.

Fields.Name: Back Home Time on Touching Enemy Wall
Fields.Description: When the NPC hits an enemy wall (a boundary that blocks enemies), the common AI scripts make it return home for this many seconds. 0: no reaction.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Forget Time
Fields.Description: Seconds before a target the NPC can no longer see is forgotten.

Fields.Name: Blocked Movement - Attack ID
Fields.Description: Attack the common AI scripts use on a breakable object that blocks the NPC's path (object defence ≤ 10, or ≤ 100 for huge enemies), drawing and sheathing the weapon around it when weapon switching is used. -1: never break obstacles.

Fields.Name: Listen - Distance
Fields.Description: Hearing range in metres, added to a sound's own radius: a sound is heard when the NPC is within radius + this distance.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Reply Action ID
Fields.Description: Attack (action) the NPC performs toward the caller after answering a call for help. -1: none. Read by the reply-help script.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Call Action ID
Fields.Description: Attack (action) the NPC performs, facing the target, when it calls for help.

Fields.Name: Vision - Distance
Fields.Description: Sight range in metres. Scaled by the darkness multiplier (unless Disable Darkness Modifier is on) and other sight multipliers, applied only to the part beyond Vision - Start Distance.

Fields.Name: Use Guard during Action
Fields.Description: When on, the NPC guards (action 9910) while sidestepping or retreating after a failed path or the return-home limit.

Fields.Name: Listen - Sound Cutoff Distance
Fields.Description: Metres subtracted from a sound's radius before the hearing check, making the NPC harder of hearing. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Smell - Distance
Fields.Description: Smell range in metres. 0: no smell sense.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Max Distance
Fields.Description: Metres from home (or its move point) beyond which the NPC stops fighting and goes home; with Back to Home Stuck Act 1 it walks back and fades to its start position. 9999: effectively never. A SpEffect can override it.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Distance
Fields.Description: Metres from home beyond which the NPC only keeps fighting targets within Retreat Home - Battle Distance; otherwise it returns or does its failed-path action. A SpEffect can override it.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Battle Distance
Fields.Description: Beyond Retreat Home - Distance, the NPC still fights a target closer than this many metres. A SpEffect can override it.

Fields.Name: Non-Battle Act Duration when in Combat
Fields.Description: Seconds of non-battle behaviour (going home) the common AI scripts run when the NPC gives up beyond Retreat Home - Max Distance.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Look for Target Time
Fields.Description: Seconds to keep watching the target while returning home.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Look for Target Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) within which the NPC watches the target while returning home.

Fields.Name: Listen - Search Forget Time
Fields.Description: Seconds before a heard sound target is forgotten. A forget time set on the sound itself (when 0 or more) takes precedence; Goal Action - To Caution set to 14 shortens this to 1 second.

Fields.Name: Battle - Start Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) at which battle should start.

Fields.Name: Call Help - My Peer ID
Fields.Description: This NPC answers calls for help from NPCs whose Call Help - Call Peer ID matches this.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Call Peer ID
Fields.Description: Group this NPC calls for help (matched against helpers' Call Help - My Peer ID). 0: never calls.

Fields.Name: Target System - Damage Effect Rate
Fields.Description: Percentage of the damage taken from a character that counts toward choosing it as the target. 100: full; 0: damage doesn't affect targeting.

Fields.Name: Team Attack Effectivity
Fields.Description: Weight of this NPC in its team's attack slots: higher values let fewer team members attack at the same time.

Fields.Name: Vision - Height Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical half-angle of sight in degrees, from straight ahead (180: all around). SpEffects can change it.

Fields.Name: Vision - Width Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal half-angle of sight in degrees, from straight ahead (180: all around). SpEffects can change it.

Fields.Name: Disable Darkness Modifier
Fields.Description: When on, sight range ignores the darkness multiplier.

Fields.Name: Caravan Role
Fields.Description: Role in a caravan platoon, read by the platoon script: 0 Attack, 1 Guard, 2 Master. Guards and the master react when one of them is damaged or in battle.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Valid Target Min Distance
Fields.Description: A call for help is only made while the target is farther than this many metres.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Valid Target Range
Fields.Description: Only allies within this many metres are called.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Forget Time by Arrival
Fields.Description: Duration (s) of the reply-help goal the common AI scripts start when the NPC answers a call.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Min Wait Time
Fields.Description: Minimum wait before answering a call for help, in tenths of a second (101 = 10.1 s).

Fields.Name: Call Help - Max Wait Time
Fields.Description: Maximum wait before answering a call for help, in tenths of a second (101 = 10.1 s).

Fields.Name: Goal Action - To Caution (Sound)
Fields.Description: What the common AI scripts do when a normal sound alerts the NPC (see the goal action list: 1 stay, 2 walk to the source, 3 run to it, 14 play animation 3501, …). 0: ignore and resume normal behaviour.

Fields.Name: Listen - Listen Level
Fields.Description: Sounds with a level above this are not heard. Default 128.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Reply Behavior Type
Fields.Description: How the NPC reaches the caller after answering: 0 walk, 1 run (it stays put within 3 m).

Fields.Name: Disable Path Move
Fields.Description: When on, the NPC moves straight toward its destination instead of following the navmesh path.

Fields.Name: Skip Arrival Visibility Check
Fields.Description: Meant to accept arrival without line of sight.

Fields.Name: Think Attribute - Do Admirer
Fields.Description: When on, the NPC takes part in surrounding the target (admirer role) instead of always attacking; read by many battle scripts through GetExcelParam and DoAdmirer_ThinkAttr.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Edge
Fields.Description: Meant to allow navmesh cliff edges.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Large Space
Fields.Description: Meant to allow wide-space navmesh.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Ladder
Fields.Description: When on, the NPC may path over ladders and periodically looks for ladders to use.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Hole
Fields.Description: Meant to allow navmesh holes.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Door
Fields.Description: Meant to allow navmesh doors.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Ignore Navmesh Wall
Fields.Description: Meant to allow navmesh inside walls.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Lava
Fields.Description: When on, the NPC may path over lava navmesh without the extra lava cost.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Cliff Edge
Fields.Description: Meant to allow cliff edges outside battle.

Fields.Name: Search Threshold - Level 0 to Level 1
Fields.Description: Search gauge points needed to reach search level 1. The gauge (0–999) rises while the NPC perceives a target and falls by 10 per second otherwise. -1: never.

Fields.Name: Search Threshold - Level 1 to Level 2
Fields.Description: Extra search gauge points, on top of Level 0 to Level 1, needed to reach search level 2. -1: never.

Fields.Name: Platoon - Reply Time
Fields.Description: Meant as the delay (s) before reacting to a platoon order.

Fields.Name: Platoon - Reply Add Random Time
Fields.Description: Meant as a random extra delay (s) for platoon reactions.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Height Angle Bonus
Fields.Description: Degrees added to Vision - Height Angle when looking for a character the NPC is already tracking (searching).

Fields.Name: Update Battle Vision
Fields.Description: When on, the Battle Vision distance and angles replace normal sight for characters the NPC is already tracking.

Fields.Name: Battle Vision - Overwrite Distance
Fields.Description: Sight range in metres used instead of Vision - Distance when Update Battle Vision is on (same multipliers).

Fields.Name: Battle Vision - Overwrite Height Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical half-angle of sight in degrees used when Update Battle Vision is on.

Fields.Name: Battle Vision - Overwrite Width Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal half-angle of sight in degrees used when Update Battle Vision is on.

Fields.Name: Target Distance Correction
Fields.Description: Metres added to the distance the AI measures to its target (negative: the target counts as nearer). An active SpEffect with its own non-zero correction replaces it. Retail 0; −20 Morgott, −10 Black Knife Assassin, −5 to −50 on a few large enemies.

Fields.Name: Unknown AI Target Radius
Fields.Description: Read when the AI sets up its target tracking: when it passes a threshold check it is passed on as a distance (m) together with a fixed 20. Its effect is not established. Retail 5 (0 on 37 rows).

Fields.Name: Unknown AI Target Value
Fields.Description: Read and stored with the AI's target tracking next to the value above. Its effect is not established. Retail 2 (0 on 37 rows).
No reader found. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Vision - Start Position - Backward Offset
Fields.Description: Moves the sight origin this many metres behind the character, so the sight cone also covers its sides.

Fields.Name: Vision - Start Distance
Fields.Description: Characters nearer than this many metres to the sight origin aren't seen; sight multipliers don't scale this part of the range.

Fields.Name: Act Type on Failed Path
Fields.Description: Action after a failed path or at the return-home limit, from the common AI scripts: 0/1 go home, 2 sidestep using Attack ID - On Ranged Attack, 3 sidestep without attacking.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Target Alerted by Important Sound
Fields.Description: What the common AI scripts do when an important sound alerts the NPC (same values as Goal Action - To Caution). 14 also shortens the sound forget time to 1 second.

Fields.Name: Shift Animation ID on Ranged Attack
Fields.Description: Animation played before the failed-path sidestep when Ranged Attack - SpEffect ID is set and not active. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Act Type on Non-BTL Failed Path
Fields.Description: What the NPC does out of battle when its path fails, from the common AI scripts: 0 stay, 1 walk around.

Fields.Name: Is Spirit Summon AI
Fields.Description: Thinking for a buddy

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Target Search Level 1
Fields.Description: What the common AI scripts do when the NPC reaches search level 1 (same values as Goal Action - To Caution). 14 also shortens the level 1 forget time to 1 second.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Target Search Level 2
Fields.Description: What the common AI scripts do when the NPC reaches search level 2 (same values as Goal Action - To Caution). 14 also shortens the level 2 forget time to 1 second.

Fields.Name: Jump Move Type
Fields.Description: Use of navmesh jump links out of battle: 0 never; 1 allowed but strongly avoided; 2 allowed freely; 3 allowed with a small cost.

Fields.Name: Disable Local Steering
Fields.Description: When on, the NPC no longer steers around other characters while moving.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Target Lost
Fields.Description: What the common AI scripts do when the NPC loses its target (same values as Goal Action - To Caution). 14 also shortens the memory forget time to 1 second.

Fields.Name: Change State Action - To Normal
Fields.Description: Action when the NPC returns to normal state, from the common AI scripts: 1 play animation 1810 toward its start position (stay if nearer than 10 m), 2 turn first, then the same.

Fields.Name: Time to Forget Target
Fields.Description: Seconds before a remembered (no longer perceived) target is forgotten.

Fields.Name: Attack ID - On Ranged Attack
Fields.Description: Attack used during the failed-path sidestep (Act Type on Failed Path 2). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Use Fall Jump - Outside of Combat
Fields.Description: Use of navmesh drop links out of battle: 0 never; 1 allowed but strongly avoided; other values allowed.

Fields.Name: Use Fall Jump - In Combat
Fields.Description: Use of navmesh drop links in battle: 0 never; 1 allowed but strongly avoided; other values allowed.

Fields.Name: Enable Jump - In Combat
Fields.Description: Use of navmesh jump links in battle: 0 never; 1 allowed but strongly avoided; 2 allowed freely; 3 allowed with a small cost.

Fields.Name: Back to Home Stuck Act
Fields.Description: 1: when the NPC is beyond Retreat Home - Max Distance or stuck returning home, it fades out and warps to its start position. 0: it walks back.

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [1]
Fields.Description: Behaviour sounds (sound type 7) are only heard when their behaviour ID matches one of the eight Sound Behavior IDs. -1: none. Scripts read the heard ID with GetLatestSoundBehaviorID.

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [2]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [3]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [4]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [5]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [6]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [7]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [8]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Weapon Switch Out - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect that marks the weapon as sheathed; with Enable Weapon Switch, the NPC draws its weapon (Weapon Switch In - Animation ID) when alerted while this is on.

Fields.Name: Weapon Switch In - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect that marks the weapon as drawn; with Enable Weapon Switch, the NPC sheathes it (Weapon Switch Out - Animation ID) when calm while this is on.

Fields.Name: Weapon Switch Out - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation that sheathes the weapon.

Fields.Name: Weapon Switch In - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation that draws the weapon.

Fields.Name: Surprised - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation played once when the NPC goes straight from unaware to battle. -1: none.
